shots.subject: A two-level wood library with a gallery running all around, a tall tree lit with warm lights in the centre of the floor, rolling ladders on the shelves, garlands along the gallery railing and tall windows with snow outside
Long oak reading tables with rows of green glass banker's lamps glowing, a pine garland with gold ribbon down the centre of each table, tall shelves and a lit tree beyond
A wrought-iron spiral staircase climbing to an upper gallery of books, its railing wound with fairy lights and garland, a small lit tree at its foot and bookshelves all around
shots.focus: the top of the spiral staircase
shots.ambient: The fairy lights glow along the staircase railing.

shots.subject: A library window seat in a deep bay between bookcases, velvet cushions, a tartan throw and a stack of old books, fairy lights around the window and snow falling on a lamplit courtyard outside
shots.motion_elements: the fairy lights and the snow outside the window

shots.subject: A brass armillary sphere and a leather wingback armchair beside a lit tree, a brass reading lamp, a garland along the nearby shelves and a fire glowing in a small fireplace
shots.motion_elements: the lamp glow, the tree lights and the fire
shots.ambient: The fire flickers in the fireplace.

shots.subject: A round domed reading room with radial desks under green lamps, curved bookcases rising three tiers to a coffered dome and a tall lit tree in the centre beneath the dome
shots.motion_elements: the green desk lamps and the tree lights

shots.subject: A baroque library hall with white and gold carved bookcases, an ornate gilded ceiling, crystal chandeliers and a long row of lit trees down the centre aisle
shots.motion_elements: the tree lights and the chandelier sparkle

shots.subject: A green glass banker's lamp glowing on a leather-topped desk beside a closed leather-bound book tied with red ribbon, a candle in a brass holder and a sprig of pine, bookshelves blurred behind

shots.subject: A long library hall with tall arched windows along one side showing snow falling on a lamplit quadrangle, bookcases between the windows, a garland with lights along the cornice and a tree at the far end

shots.motion_elements: the fairy lights and the lamp glow
shots.ambient: The lamp glows warmly out of focus.

shots.subject: A Victorian iron-and-glass library with cast-iron galleries on slim columns, lamps glowing on every level, a very tall tree rising through the atrium and snow falling on the glass roof above
